concerns.text: T017a-3 applies Median Split ONLY to 'edge_density' to assign 'complexity_category'. This violates FR-001 (compute 3 metrics) and Plan.md 'Complexity Tracking' (PCA/Dimensionality check to avoid cherry-picking). The task silently weakens the requirement to use a multivariate construct (edge, entropy, fractal) for the independent variable, reducing it to a single metric.

T034 requires calculating 'partial η²' (partial eta-squared). FR-003 and Amendment 001 explicitly replaced ANOVA with a Permutation Test. Permutation Tests do not yield partial η²; this metric is mathematically invalid for the chosen method. The task demands a deliverable that contradicts the amended statistical method.

T035 mandates running a Permutation Test (n=1000) for every step of the Threshold Sweep and LOIO. Plan.md SC-005 constrains runtime to ≤6h on 2-core CPU. Running 1000 permutations for N_images + N_thresholds iterations likely exceeds this limit. The task fails to preserve the performance constraint unless the optimization (n=100) mentioned in the text is made a hard requirement, not an optional note.

T027a-Map assigns 'stimulus_set_id' based on the 'complexity_category' from T017a-3. Since T017a-3 uses only 'edge_density' (a single metric), this task propagates the single-metric simplification. This violates Constitution Principle VII ('Quantified Stimulus Metrics') which requires metrics (plural) to define the independent variable, and Plan.md 'Complexity Tracking' which rejects single-metric cherry-picking.

T034b implements Power Analysis using 'TTestIndPower' (Independent T-Test) and target 'η²'. The study design (Permutation Test on D-scores from counterbalanced sessions) is not an independent t-test. This creates a methodological mismatch where the power analysis tool does not match the actual analysis method, violating the requirement for valid statistical inference.

T000 creates 'amendment-001.md' but lacks a step to update the project state file ('state/projects/...yaml') 'updated_at' timestamp. Constitution Principle V ('Versioning Discipline') requires every artifact change to update this timestamp. The task silently omits this mandatory versioning step.
